newsitem.title: GERMANY: DT cable TV network in 16.4 mln homes.
newsitem.headline: DT cable TV network in 16.4 mln homes.

text.p: Deutsche Telekom AG (DT), the German telecommunications giant, said on Monday its cable television network connected 16.4 million homes at the end of September, an increase of 194,000 since the end of June.
While DT owns the cable television backbone network, it only has around 6.5 million of all cable TV subscribers under direct contract.
Independent cable operators service the remaining cable subscribers.
The total number of homes passed by the network, indicating how many households could be connected, rose to 24.7 million at the end of September from 24.2 million at the end of June.
The penetration of the cable TV network rose to 66.1 percent of German households last month from 64.7 percent at the beginning of the year.
There are 37.4 million households in Germany.
